candidate.name: Headscale Self-hosted
candidate.free_limit: Free BSD-3-Clause self-hosted control server for one Tailscale-compatible tailnet; no provider-enforced node, request, or monthly usage quota. Includes node registration, ACLs, MagicDNS, subnet routers, exit nodes, and an embedded DERP relay.
